content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having trouble connecting my [product_name] [article_no] to my computer. I want to change the device's interface to PC/Card, but only 'card' is available. I connect the device to my PC using a COM to USB cable since my PC only has USB ports, but I still can't find the device or the desired interface. When I check with [product_name], it detects the COM port, but I can't get the device into the correct interface mode. Do you have any suggestions? By the way, the device also has an additional module [article_no]. Thanks

First, select the interface on your [product_name]: [product_name] <-> PC. If you've installed the USB driver with [product_name], you should be able to find the correct interface under TOOLS -> Options -> Interface. It doesn't matter whether you're connecting through the COM (RS232) or USB port.

Hello, thanks for your response. My issue isn't with [product_name], but with the [product_name] device itself. I can't select the correct interface, as it only shows 'card' as an option. My PC doesn't appear on the device. Could the issue be with my [product_name] cable?

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter difficulties connecting a [product_name] [article_no] to a PC via a COM-to-USB adapter. The device only offers the 'Card' interface instead of 'PC/Card,' which prevents direct communication, even though [product_name] detects the COM port.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to easily switch the device interface and for the PC connection to work seamlessly for transferring projects or configuring settings.
